notes.title: The Final Flame Beta ver 0.1.3.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The game has been updated to version 0.1.3.4 and here is the entire list of content to look forward to and test, along with a roadmap of what's to come.

Characters:
* - Only available in closed beta
[list]
[*]Zaf
[*]Hitori Achlyz(Blue)
[*]Kkunkiyo
[*]Zurandus
[*]SoraKohi
[*]Rosen
[*]*Aartha
[*]Hitori Achylz(Black)
[/list]
Falucites:
Tier 1:
[list]
[*]Spark Shot
[*]Fire Ball
[*]Snow Shot
[*]Tremor
[*]Heal
[*]Dark Surge
[/list]
Tier 2:
[list]
[*]Lightning Bolt
[*]Ember
[*]Hailstone
[*]Earthquake
[*]Serenity
[*]Dark Swords
[/list]
Tier 3:
[list]
[*]Lightning Grid
[*]Blaze Gate
[*]Ice Tomb
[*]Fissure
[*]Skybolt
[*]Mildibalyir
[*]Solar Beam
[*]Valoroso
[/list]

Mobs:
[list]
[*]Bandit
[*]Wolf[Wind, Fire, Ice, Earth, Holy, Dark]
[*]Mercenary 3rd Class
[*]Mercenary 2nd Class
[*]Mercenary 1st Class
[*]Tengu[Wind, Dark, Ice]
[*]Orc[Wind, Fire, Earth]
[*] Porkknights
[*]Wyvern[Wind, Fire, Ice, Holy, Dark]
[/list]

Bosses:
() - Rooms boss appears in
[list]
[*]Golden Snake Emperor(Fire, Earth, Dark)
[*]Layla Caelum, The Holy Knight(Ice, Earth, Holy)
[*]Rabine, The Rabbit-Wolf Hybrid(Wind, Ice, Holy)
[/list]

From hereon out the game's development will shift more towards the steam version, so expect that the updates after will include Steam Achievements and cards, the idea of adding an online leaderboards is still being considered as it affects store ratings and policies for having interactions go beyond the game's executable.

The next update for the closed beta will be the inclusion of the last batch of characters:
[list]
[*]Aka Furea
[*]Velaerys
[*]ItazuraKid
[*]Clamiel
[*]Edward Vincent
[/list]
Zaf will also be locked in future updates for the closed beta until further notice as the story and the finality of the game is being developed, to avoid spoilers till then, a new character will be added that features the same stats/growth/abilities.

The game will be aiming to for a September 1, 2025 - November 2, 2025 release window and expect the game will be priced at $6.99. All of this are still tentative and are subject to change until release, but we'll do our best to stick to what has been announced.

Thank you everyone for taking the time to test the game, and we'll make sure your work does not go unnoticed and include all closed beta testers in the credits in the future builds

Regards, 
The Bread Igniter

notes.title: Beta hotfix ver 0.1.3.3
notes.content:
Fixed Kkunkiyo[Character]'s movement when using mouse and keyboard.

Drops for tier 3 falucites: Lightning Grid, Blaze Gate, Ice Tomb has been enabled and can be obtained at a 1% drop rate from level 40+ mobs of their respective element.

notes.content: Added new mobs Tengus and Orcs

notes.title: Patch Notes for Beta ver 0.1.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]MarcZaf's The Final Flame Beta Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]v. 0.1.3.0[/h2]


[h3]Characters:[/h3]
Aartha
[list]
[*] Base END increased from 5 -> 8
[*] Base EP decreased from 60 -> 40
[*] Energy Blade[Trait] EP gain on hit reduced from 3 -> 2
[*] Tree of Yggdrasil[Ultimate] healing reduced from 25% -> 5% Magic Attack
[/list]
Hitori(Mist)
[list]
[*] Base Dodge Rate increased from 10% -> 15%
[*] Mist Shot[Skill] Fixed Ability scaling. Now fires additional projectiles at random directions. EP Cost reduced from 20 -> 15
[*] Rosen
[*] Base BRK reduced from 5 -> 4
[/list]
SoraKohi
[list]
[*] Another Round[Trait] Coffee Beans will only last 4 seconds on the field.
[/list]
Zurandus
[list]
[*] Base BRK reduced from 7 -> 5
[/list]

[h3]Falucites[/h3]
Dark Swords[Dark]
[list]
[*] Now gives 1 POW bonus. EP cost Reduced from 30 -> 26
[*] Increased number of hits by 2
[/list]
Earthquake[Earth]
[list]
[*] Reduced DEF Bonus from 30 -> 20, Now has a 2 STR Penalty
[/list]
Hailstones[Ice]
[list]
[*] Now applies Break damage. Range reduced from 320 -> 256
[/list]
		
[h3]Blessing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Energy Siphon[Ice] Increased Energy restored from [3,6,9] -> [10,20,30]
[/list]

[h3]Dungeon[/h3]
Mutations have been added.
[list]
[*] After defeating a boss, it will grant 2 buffs to all dungeon mobs.
[/list]
Golden Snake Emperor
[list]
[*] adjusted Pierce attack hitbox
[/list]
Rabine, The Rabbit-Wolf Hybrid
[list]
[*] adjusted Pounce attack hitbox
[*] Base HP reduced from 14,000 -> 12,000
[*] Increased Regular and Elite mobs' HP scaling.
[/list]
Follymaker has been added.
Folly will act as a shop for random blessings.
[list]
[*] A random blessing will approximately cost 2,000 gold.
[*] price may vary depending on number of purchases, dungeon level, and whether or not Folly will give a discount.
[/list]
			
[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Partial Controller support added.
[*] Fixed a glitch where the game will only read the system save on start up.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Stormy Spell[Trait] will not cast on specific characters.
[/list]
